title: 2026 Subaru Outback review: Great interior, refined drive, divisive looks
summary: Today, the 2026 Outback marks a new era in the model’s history. The Outback offers 34.6 cubic feet (980 L) of cargo space behind the rear seats and 80.5 cu. ft. (2,280 L) with rear seats folded.
